Frequently asked questions

Are there programmes for children and adults?

Yes. Age requirements vary by programme; ask the academy about current options.

Are fees and schedules listed here?

They can change by programme and term. The academy team will provide current details.

Is an enquiry a confirmed enrolment?

No. It begins a conversation; enrolment is confirmed after discussing the programme with the academy.
